content:
Laredo police officers spent Saturday morning at the McDonald's on Lomas del Sur, meeting neighbors and helping families sign up their children for the department's Blue Santa program.

Officers were on hand to connect with the community and walk families through the Blue Santa sign-up process, so children in need can receive gifts this holiday season.

The Laredo Police Department thanked everyone who stopped by, and thanked McDonald's for welcoming officers and supporting the event.

Source: Laredo Police Department, November 7, 2026.
